column1: # Role of each package for the task packages task-sparky-stereo-<role> (Daniel, 2026-10-07:
# "fine grain meta packages - like designer, gammer and such - all with stereo naming", "task
# packages as well - old debian user here"). Columns: package, roles (comma separated).
# Packages of apps.list not named here stay in sparky-stereo-desktop, the core everyone gets.
# Packages named here but in no list are role-only: they install with their task.
# Roles: gamer designer creator musician scientist student simmer maker engineer developer os-developer
# Third column, for scientist and student only (Daniel: "for those edu and science - issue stereo
# and non-stereo meta and tasks - so people can install the missing non-stereo without conflicting
# with our stereo ones"): 3d = shows stereo on Sparky Stereo OS today (SOLUTIONS.md), into
# task-sparky-stereo-<role>; 2d = not yet, into task-sparky-<role>. A program moves to 3d when
# --- gamer: the games, gaming and runtimes lists go here whole (make-meta.py), plus:
# --- scientist: science and engineering (our stereo builds first)
# --- simmer: flight and racing simulators and their rigs
# --- maker: 3D printing (Daniel, 2026-10-08, after Karan_Luciano's reply on Diolinux: "find the 3d
# printing software - include'em - kde has something? - open source first always"); blender,
# freecad, kicad, openscad and f3d carry maker above. Not in Debian testing, ours to package
# (notes/3d-printing.md): KDE's AtCore and Atelier, OrcaSlicer, Dune 3D, Printrun, UVtools; current
# Cura (Debian has 5.0.0 of 2022). PrusaSlicer and MeshLab come from Debian once they reach testing.
# --- engineer: electrical and automation (Daniel, 2026-10-08: "include any linux opensource - closed as
# well for us to contact where possible - SCADA software (EE)"); kicad and freecad carry engineer above.
# Not in Debian testing, ours to package (notes/ee-scada.md): Qucs-S, OpenModelica, the SCADA and HMI
# programs (FUXA, Scada-LTS, OpenSCADA, Rapid SCADA, Node-RED), the PLC tools (OpenPLC runtime, Beremiz,
# Eclipse 4diac) and the power-system simulators (GridLAB-D, pandapower, PyPSA, OpenDSS).
# --- developer: code and game engines (Daniel, 2026-10-16); developer.list goes here whole (make-meta.py), plus our builds
# that Debian does not carry. Karton is KDE's virtual machine manager (a pre-alpha; virt-manager stays in the list).
# --- os-developer: build, test and package the edition (Daniel, 2026-10-16); os-developer.list goes here whole, and
# make-meta.py puts the development files of our stereo stack in Depends at our versions; these are the other development
# packages and test programs of our builds.
